findings.claim: The R2-1 fix puts every held card that the refreshed first page leaves out into `kept`, including a card the server still counts but that a new clip pushed onto page 2. A later menu trash of that card is then never subtracted from the drawn count.
findings.impact: A Clips shelf page (for example Unread) that has more than one page of clips but only the first page loaded shows a full page of cards. When a new clip arrives (knowledge.clip.ready or the clip section), the last card is pushed onto server page 2 but stays drawn. If the user then trashes that card through the menu, the card leaves but the header count stays the same, one too high.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/clipsapp/usePagedClips.ts:94-97 sets `pages = 1` whenever the drawn items fit one page (`ceil(items.length / pageSize)`, so exactly pageSize drawn gives 1). Lines 112-114 keep every held item the page-1 answer omits (`pages === 1`). Line 127 then sets `kept` to all of those items, assuming the server does not count them. Line 221 removes `kept` ids from `counted`. clipsapp/ShelfPage.tsx header draws `data.count - lists.removedCount(listKey, data.counted)`. A card pushed from page 1 to page 2 by a newer clip is still in `page.count` (line 123) but is in `kept`, so removedCount ignores it after a menu trash. ShelfPage uses `paged: true`, so there is no cap to cut it (useShelfData.ts:77).
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Steps from reading the code: Unread shelf page, server holds pageSize+1 unread clips a1..a(N+1), and page 1 shows a1..aN with count N+1. A new clip n arrives, so refresh asks page 1 = [n, a1..a(N-1)] with count N+2. Then held = [n, a1..a(N-1), aN], kept = {aN}, and the header reads N+2. Trash aN through the menu: aN leaves the grid, removedCount(counted) = 0, and the header still reads N+2 where it should read N+1. No test covers it: the two tests added in d4eabe1 use 3 clips, so `kept` only ever holds truly uncounted ids.

bucket_proposal.reason: I3: a count drawn for the list drops by one per card that leaves it. Here it drops by zero for a card that leaves.

findings.proposed_fix: Count only removed ids the latest answer actually counted. For example, record the server count at removal time, or mark `kept` ids as uncounted only when the answer's count shows they are absent (fresh.length + kept.length > count). The simpler option is for a menu trash to call the shelf's own `remove(id)`, so the hook's count stays authoritative and the page-level subtraction is not needed.

findings.claim: The R2-1 regression tests cannot tell the correct `kept` rule from the over-broad one, because no test refreshes a shelf whose omitted cards are still counted by the server.
findings.impact: A count that drifts after a refresh, in either direction, in lists larger than one page would pass CI.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/__tests__/clipsCardMenu.test.tsx: both new cases ('after a trash, a refresh for a new clip draws Unread's count from the server alone' on Home and on the Unread page) use clips(3). There the only omitted held card is the trashed one, so `kept` equal to 'all omitted items' and `kept` equal to 'trashed omitted items' give the same result.
findings.repro: Mutation reasoning: change usePagedClips.ts:127 so it keeps only ids that the page-level menu has trashed. Both new tests still pass. The reverse mutation (current code) passes too. Not run.

specification_compliance: R2-1 as reported (double subtraction after a refresh on a one-page Home shelf or shelf page) is fixed by d4eabe1 for the reported path: the trashed id lands in `kept` and is excluded from `counted`.
The same fix introduces an under-subtraction for a held card that a refresh pushed beyond page 1 but the server still counts (R3-1, I3).

potential_unspecified_behavior: usePagedClips keeps held cards that a refresh omitted on screen (pages === 1), and now also excludes them from the count basis even when the server still counts them.
regression_risks: Count correctness in Clips now depends on three interacting mechanisms: `unnamed` retention, the `kept` set, and the page-level removedCount. Each assumes something different about what the server's count includes.
`kept` is reset by a reread loadMore but carried over by a plain loadMore, so it can outlive the answer it described.
test_coverage: The new Home and shelf-page tests kill reverting `counted` back to `items`.
No test covers a refresh that pushes a still-counted card off page 1 (R3-1).
The R2-2 e2e callout gap remains.

trajectory: d4eabe1 adds a new state to usePagedClips: the `kept` set, plus the derived `counted` list. It sits on top of the `pages` and reread prediction that the previous round added, the `unnamed` retention, and the page-level removedCount subtraction. The previous round likewise added a prediction (`total + removedBefore` in fetchAlignedPage) to correct a symptom of predicting server boundaries from removed counts. Here a new state again corrects the count symptom, and the correction is itself an approximation that misclassifies counted cards (R3-1). The design is being patched. No round removed a branch or state. 494df10 and e2fdf4c are review records only.
